label: Archer A
identity_view: front, front-right oblique, right profile, rear-right oblique, back in row-major order
description: The original adult male archer: stern dark tan-brown clean-shaven human face beneath a small domed dark steel helmet with a narrow brass rim, short central spike and two small upcurved ivory side horns. Silver-gray chainmail coif covers the neck and back of the head; dark gray fine chainmail sleeves cover the arms beneath a plain short green-teal tabard. Preserve the exact native large white heraldic bird emblem across the chest, its outspread wings and descending tail, partially crossed by a brown diagonal quiver strap. Bright muted brass-gold gorget, small dark steel shoulder plates with brass edging and visible studs, plain brown waist belt with round brass buckle. Ochre-brown fitted trousers and tall plain brown leather boots; preserve original native cuff seams and coverage. The right hand holds the curved dark brown wooden bow with a fine pale bowstring, at the exact native angle. The left hand has an ochre leather glove and is empty except in native arrow-handling poses. A brown leather arrow quiver lies diagonally across the back with several thin pale shafts and white-gray feather fletchings projecting above the shoulder. Preserve native proportions, dark tonal weight, tabard green, brown leather and simple practical materials. No sword, shield, cape, extra ornaments, glow or costume redesign. Native cloth palette variants will be derived offline; keep the white emblem, armor, skin, leather, arrows and bow protected.
